blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: High-beam-count LiDAR sensors are costly, yet many perception pipelines require dense angular sampling. Using a pretrained Stable Diffusion model as the backbone, we fine-tune a LiDAR-conditioned depth model with pseudo-depth targets from a 2D foundation model. During training, the LiDAR conditioning is randomly decimated at different beam budgets. We then investigate how much of a LiDAR scan can be recovered from heavily decimated input and characterize performance across the input beam budget. We evaluate against physically held-out real beams on nuScenes and report recovery separately from fit accuracy. Our model yields its largest advantage in very sparse regimes, achieving a δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} accuracy of 66.8 66.8 % from 4 4 -beam input where scattered interpolation reaches only 45.1 45.1 %. A class-stratified error breakdown further reveals that planar surfaces recover first while objects introducing depth discontinuities degrade earliest. Together, these results quantify the recovery/resolution trade-off for foundation-model-guided LiDAR enhancement.
blocks.zh: 高梁计数 LiDAR传感器成本很高,但许多感知管需要密集的角取样. 以预训稳定分流模型为骨干,从2D基础模型中微调出有伪深度目标的LiDAR条件深度模型. 在训练期间,LiDAR调制在不同的光束预算上被随机歼灭. 然后我们调查LiDAR扫描能从大量大量消耗的输入中回收多少,并描述整个输入束预算的性能. 我们对照核磁场上的实相束进行评估,并报告恢复情况与适当的准确性分开。 我们的模型在非常稀少的制度中获得了最大的优势,从4个4个波束输入中实现了66.8%的精度,而分散的插值只达到45.1。 45.1% (英语). 分类分解的误差进一步表明,平面首先恢复,而引入深度不连续的物体最早降解。 这些结果共同量化了对基础模型指导的LiDAR增强的恢复/分辨率取舍。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Accurate 3D geometric perception is fundamental to autonomous navigation. Consequently, LiDAR sensing systems have gained widespread adoption in automotive and robotic applications [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . However, high-resolution LiDAR sensors carry a steep cost in terms of energy and data rate consumption, despite being the superior choice for 3D scene understanding. Low beam-count sensors offer a realistic trade-off between overall system cost and performance. A recurring practical question is therefore whether a low-beam sensor can be used to approximate the angular fidelity of a costly one. Several recent works address LiDAR generation using diffusion-based frameworks [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . These models operate on spherical range images, parameterized by the LiDAR’s elevation and azimuth angles. Even though this formulation is a native representation of sensor geometry, it is confined to the sensor’s own measurement manifold. In contrast, models operating in camera-space can inject dense priors from 2D foundation models, including geometry, semantics, and object boundaries learned at web scale, into the recovery process [ 9 ] . Diffusion-based LiDAR upsampling is most often cast as a masked completion or super-resolution task (Sec. II-B ), typically relying on high-resolution LiDAR supervision. Building upon the architecture introduced in [ 9 ] , our approach operates without high-resolution LiDAR supervision and recovers physically held-out beams as dense depth maps in the camera view from sparse LiDAR conditioning under 2D foundation model supervision.
Concretely, our contributions are as follows: • We report a degradation curve of recovery accuracy as a function of input beam budget, evaluated against held-out real beams. • We provide a class-stratified failure analysis, inspecting where recovery breaks down first under very sparse inputs. • We inspect the influence of scene prompt description on reconstruction quality, when a large portion of information is missing.
blocks.zh:
精确的3D几何感知是自主导航的根本. 因此,LiDAR传感器在汽车和机器人应用[1、2、3]中得到广泛采用。 然而,高分辨率 LiDAR传感器在能耗和数据速率消耗方面承担了高昂的成本,尽管是3D场景理解的上等选择. 低光束计数传感器在总体系统成本和性能之间提供了现实的取舍。 因此,一个反复出现的实际问题是,低光束传感器是否可以用来大致显示一个昂贵的传感器的角质。 近期的多部作品利用以传播为基础的框架处理LiDAR生成问题[4、5、6、7、8]。 这些模型在球形范围图像上运行,由LiDAR的高和方位角参数化. 尽管这种配方是传感器几何的本土代表,但仅限于传感器自己的测量多面体。 相比之下,相机空间运行的模型可以从2D基础模型中注入密集的前兆,包括几何,语义,以及从网络尺度上学习到的对象边界,进入恢复过程[9]. 以扩散为主的LiDAR上下采样最常被铸作为被蒙蔽的完成或超分辨率任务(Sec. II-B),一般依靠高分辨率的LiDAR监督. 在[9]所引入的架构基础上,我们的方法在没有高分辨率LiDAR监督的情况下运作,并在2D地基模型监督下从摄像头视野中从稀疏的LiDAR调制中取回作为密集深度图的物理被挡出束.
具体来说,我们的贡献如下: 我们报告回收精度的退化曲线,作为投入光束预算的一项功能,对照被搁置的真光束进行评估。 我们提供分级的故障分析,检查恢复首先在极少投入下出现的情况。 我们检查现场迅速描述对重建质量的影响,因为大部分信息缺失。

blocks.en: The study is scoped to camera-view depth recovery against real held-out measurements, characterizing the additional properties of image-space diffusion relative to the native spherical domain representation.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的范围是针对真实的被搁置测量的相机-取景深度回放,其特征是相对于原生球状域代表的图像-空间传播的额外特性.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Generative LiDAR Models
blocks.zh: II-A 基因LiDAR 模型

blocks.en: Motivated by the success of diffusion and score-based generative models [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] , a growing body of work models LiDAR scans directly in their native spherical range representation [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] , extending image-domain latent diffusion [ 13 ] to the range image parameterized by sensor azimuth and elevation. These models draw their prior entirely from the sensor’s own measurement manifold, which preserves range statistics but ties the model to a single sensor geometry. Our setting instead conditions an image diffusion model on the projected scans and draws its prior from outside the LiDAR distribution. We therefore view our approach as complementary, trading native 360°  coverage for access to dense 2D priors.
blocks.zh: 受传播和分数基因模型[10,11,12]的成功驱动,LiDAR一大批工作模型直接在其原生球形范围代表[4,5,6,7,8]中进行扫描,将图像域潜在传播[13]扩展至由传感器方位角和高程所分出的范围图像参数. 这些模型完全取自传感器本身的测量多面体,它保留了测距统计,但将模型与单个传感器几何相挂钩。 我们的设定则对投影扫描上的图像传播模型设置了条件,并从LiDAR分布之外提取其前身. 因此,我们认为我们的方法是互补的,以360°的本地覆盖率交易,以获取密集的2D前科。

blocks.en: II-B LiDAR Completion and Super-Resolution
blocks.zh: II-B LiDAR 完成和超级解析

blocks.en: Several range-domain diffusion models address sparse scan completion, but by different mechanisms. R2DM [ 5 ] performs completion at sampling time via RePaint-style inpainting [ 14 ] . RangeLDM [ 8 ] trains a conditional latent diffusion model for upsampling, mapping a sparse range image to a dense one under dense-LiDAR supervision. A separate line of work fuses sparse projected depth maps with registered camera images to regress dense metric depth [ 15 , 16 ] , typically supervised by accumulated LiDAR. Lastly, [ 17 ] demonstrates the robustness of diffusion-based dense depth estimation under sparsity within the 2D image domain. Unlike these approaches, we require no dense-LiDAR supervision, train under a continuum of beam budgets, and measure per-beam recovery on physically held-out points in camera-view depth. This enables evaluation of camera-space depth recovery under physically decimated LiDAR conditioning rather than dense-LiDAR supervised upsampling.
blocks.zh: 多个范围域传播模型处理的是稀有扫描完成,但通过不同的机制. R2DM [5] 在采样时通过RePaint-syle-inpainting [14] 完成. RangeLDM [8] 训练一种有条件的潜在扩散模型,用于取样,在稠密-LiDAR监督下将一个稀有的射程图像映射到一个稠密的图像上. 单独的一行工作引信有稀疏的投影深度图,上面有已登记的相机图像来倒转密集的测量深度[15,16],通常由累积的LiDAR监督。 最后,[17] 表明基于扩散的密集深度估计在二维图像域内的螺旋性下是可靠的。 与这些方法不同的是,我们不需要密集的LiDAR监督,在连续的光束预算下进行列车,在相机-视深处的物理被挡出点上测量每束的恢复. 这使得能够评价在物理损毁的LiDAR调制下进行相机-空间深度回取,而不是由密集-LiDAR监督的上采样。

blocks.en: III-C Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 三-C 评价议定书

blocks.en:
Depth recovery is evaluated on the held-out point set 𝒫 H \mathcal{P}_{H} of the nuScenes [ 21 ] validation split. For each unseen scene, the procedure in Sec. III-B is applied at a fixed beam budget, yielding the disjoint retained and held-out sets. This enforces separation at two levels: unseen scenes prevent scene-level memorization, while held-out beams prevent evaluation from reducing to a mere reproduction of the conditioning measurements. Dense per-view relative depth is then aligned to metric scale and shift by least-squares using only the retained points 𝒫 R \mathcal{P}_{R} . The aligned metric depth is scored against the held-out returns at their projected pixel locations.
We report the Absolute Mean Relative Error (AbsRel) , Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} metrics widely adopted in dense depth estimation literature [ 22 , 23 , 17 , 24 ] . As a baseline, the retained projection is densified using nearest-neighbor scattered interpolation over valid retained pixels. This isolates the contribution of the learned prior from geometry recoverable by interpolation alone. We skip the affine transformation for the baselines given their native metric scale.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: IV-A Setup
blocks.zh: 设置

blocks.en:
Training is performed on the nuScenes [ 21 ] training split under randomized beam decimation (Sec. III-B ) and evaluated on the validation split. The U-Net is initialized with Stable Diffusion 1.5 weights. Dense depth pseudo-labels are generated with Depth Anything 3 [ 24 ] using the depth preprocessing procedure described in [ 9 ] . All recovery metrics are computed on held-out beams, with per-view scale and shift fit on retained beams only (Sec. III-C ).
We trace the degradation curve (Fig. 2 left) by evaluating every integer budget b ∈ { 4 , … , 32 } b\in\{4,\dots,32\} . We train for 100 epochs on mixed precision using AdamW with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , weight decay of 0.01 0.01 and a minimum learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} on a cosine schedule with 1000 warmup steps. We use a batch size of 32 with 6 views per batch on 8 NVIDIA A40 GPUs, resulting in an effective batch size of 1536 1536 .

blocks.en: IV-B Degradation Curve
blocks.zh: IV-B 降解曲线

blocks.en: TABLE I reports representative budgets, while the full curve appears in Fig. 2 (left). The proposed model outperforms interpolation at every budget, with the largest AbsRel improvement in the sparsest regime, where geometry cannot be recovered by interpolation alone ( 0.692 0.692 vs. 0.260 0.260 at b = 4 b\!=\!4 ). The gap narrows as beam density increases and interpolation becomes more effective ( 0.151 0.151 vs. 0.271 0.271 at b = 16 b\!=\!16 ). Recovery error decreases monotonically as more beams are retained and plateaus at b = 16 b\!=\!16 . The full-density fit metric ( b = 32 b\!=\!32 ) provides a reference for reconstruction without beam withholding, yielding AbsRel 0.147 0.147 . A qualitative example of geometric reconstruction with b = 8 b\!=\!8 is given in Fig. 1 .

blocks.en: IV-C Class-Stratified Recovery
blocks.zh: 四-C级分级回收

blocks.en: Recovery error is stratified by semantic class and tracked across beam budgets (Fig. 2 right). Recovery is strongly class-dependent and primarily driven by scene geometry rather than object category. Large planar surfaces (driveable surface, sidewalk, terrain) are reconstructed most accurately, consistent with the stronger geometric constraints provided by their locally smooth structure. Error increases for classes with dominant vertical extent and sharp depth boundaries (manmade, vegetation, barrier) and is highest for large vehicles (truck, trailer, bus, and construction vehicle). One possible explanation is that thin or irregular objects are more difficult to recover because sparse observations provide limited geometric constraints, leaving multiple depth configurations compatible with the observations. This interpretation is consistent with the observed budget dependence: large-vehicle error decreases rapidly as additional beams are retained, whereas planar surfaces show only marginal improvement. A partial vertical profile may be more compatible with multiple vehicle geometries, leaving unconstrained dimensions ambiguous until additional beams provide stronger geometric cues. Nevertheless, a residual error gap persists across all budgets, suggesting that depth discontinuities remain difficult to recover consistently across semantic classes. Thin and dynamic objects (pedestrian, bicycle, motorcycle) provide too few held-out beams per budget for reliable analysis. We therefore refrain from detailed interpretation but include them for completeness (dashed line). A more thorough analysis of output variance under severe decimation is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 回收错误按语义分类进行分级,并跟踪到横跨波束预算(图2右方). 恢复高度依赖类,主要由场景几何而非物体类别所驱动. 大型平面(可移动地表,人行道,地势)重建最为准确,符合由地平面结构提供的更强几何限制. 垂直程度和深度界限(人造、植被、屏障)为主的类别,误差增加,大型车辆(卡车、拖车、公共汽车和建筑车辆)误差最高。 一种可能的解释是:薄或不规则的物体较难恢复,因为稀有的观测提供了有限的几何约束,留下了与观测相容的多深度配置. 这种解释与所观察到的预算依赖是一致的:大车辆误差随着额外梁被保留而迅速减少,而平面则仅显示出微不足道的改善. 部分垂直剖面可能更能与多辆车辆相兼容,使得不受约束的维度模糊,直到额外的束提供更强大的几何提示. 然而,所有预算都存在遗留的错误差距,这表明语义类的深度不连续仍然难以持续恢复。 薄而活泼的物体(佩德斯特里安、自行车、摩托车)为可靠的分析提供了很少的被搁置的光束。 因此,我们不作详细解释,而是将它们包括在内,以求完整。 今后的工作需要更彻底地分析严重损耗下的产出差异。

blocks.en: IV-D Effect of Scene Prompt
blocks.zh: 四-D 场景提示的效果

blocks.en: We compare recovery with and without scene-description conditioning to assess whether textual context aids reconstruction under severe beam sparsity. Scene conditioning provides no benefit for geometric recovery and marginally degrades it at every budget. This indicates that depth reconstruction depends primarily on the LiDAR conditioning rather than semantic scene context. Accordingly, the no-scene configuration is used as the primary setting for the reported results.
blocks.zh: 我们比较恢复情况与没有场景描述条件的情况,以评估文字上下文是否有助于在严重波纹下重建。 场景条件对几何恢复没有任何好处,在每一预算中都略微降低。 这表明深度重建主要取决于LiDAR条件,而不是语义场景上下文. 因此,将无场景配置作为报告成果的主要设定。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This work investigated camera-space LiDAR depth recovery under physically motivated beam decimation. We trained a single model across the full range of beam budgets and evaluated recovery exclusively on physically held-out LiDAR beams. The model outperforms nearest-neighbor interpolation at every budget, particularly in the sparsest regime ( δ 1.25 \delta_{1.25} of 66.8 66.8 % versus 45.1 45.1 % at b = 4 b\!=\!4 ), while recovery largely plateaus beyond b = 16 b\!=\!16 , approaching the performance obtained without decimation. Scene-description conditioning yielded no measurable benefit, suggesting that recovery is driven primarily by the LiDAR conditioning. The class-stratified analysis further shows that recovery quality depends strongly on the geometric structure. These results characterize the practical limits of camera-space depth recovery as LiDAR sampling density decreases and provide a basis for evaluating learned LiDAR enhancement under sensor sparsity.
blocks.zh: 这项工作调查了相机空间LiDAR深度在物理激发光束破坏下恢复的情况。 我们训练了整个梁形预算的单一模式,并完全在实际搁置的LiDAR梁上评价回收情况。 该模型在每一个预算,特别是在最简陋的政权(  1.25\delta_{1.25}66.8 66.8%,在b = 4 b\!!4 时为45.1 45.1%)中,优于近邻的插值,而恢复大多超过b = 16 b\! !!16,接近在不造成人员伤亡的情况下取得的业绩。 场景描述条件没有产生可衡量的效益,说明恢复主要由LiDAR条件驱动. 分级分析还进一步表明,恢复质量在很大程度上取决于几何结构。 这些结果将相机-空间深度回收的实际限度描述为LiDAR采样密度下降,并为评价在感光相片性下获得的LiDAR增强提供了依据。
